description: Silica-gel/water adsorption chiller. Extends F1a with part-load COP degradation due to incomplete adsorption/desorption at short half-cycle times and cycling losses. COP_pl = COP_full * PLF where PLF = 1 - C_d*(1-PLR).

unit.name: Generic 50 kW_th silica-gel/water adsorption chiller
unit.source: Saha, B.B. et al. (1995). Heat Recovery Systems & CHP 15, 581-590; Wang, R.Z., Oliveira, R.G. (2006). Prog. Energy Combust. Sci. 32, 424-458; Duong, X.Q. et al. (2018). Energy Conv. Mgmt. 158, 77-90; Boelman et al. (1995).

C_d.note: Adsorption chiller has higher C_d than vapor-compression (0.35 vs 0.20) because incomplete half-cycle severely penalizes COP — Duong et al. (2018) cycling loss data

PLR_min.note: Minimum stable PLR; below 30% the half-cycle is too short for silica-gel to equilibrate — Wang & Oliveira (2006) sec.4

cycling_loss_factor.note: Extra COP fraction lost per on/off event from thermal mass of sorbent beds — Boelman et al. (1995)

half_cycle_time_design.note: Design half-cycle time for full adsorption equilibrium — Saha et al. (1995)

tau_penalty_exponent.note: PLR-dependent half-cycle shortening: tau_actual/tau_design ≈ PLR^0.5; COP scales as 1-exp(-k*tau) — Duong et al. (2018) Fig.7
